description: This file defines a DateTime extension for the Tiptap editor, providing commands and input rules for inserting formatted date, time, day, and date-time strings, as well as a function to replace date/time placeholders in text.

classes.name: DateTime
classes.description: A Tiptap extension that adds commands and input rules for inserting formatted date and time strings.

methods.name: replaceDateTime
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a string with formatted current date/time values based on specified formats.
